description.text:
Designation: Asst Manager

	Accountable for ensuring IT availability in Wipro, CDC locations for more than 20000 users, nearly 200 Projects, Data Center and VIP Support.
	Reviewing the internal vendors / OEM’s and driving the support within SLA.
	Tracking SIP’s from Vendors and analyzing performance.
	Driving Management Initiatives and critical projects within stringent deadlines.
	Taking ownership of end user and leadership team escalations and drive the same within respective teams and update them on status.
	Manage all external, internal & Client specific audits and close them successfully. Also  ensuring the locations are compliant to all Audit requirements.
	Managing business review meetings with project owners and drive team to close action points.
	Project possible outages and take preventive measures / Corrective Actions.
	Enabling BCP/ DR solutions for all the required projects and suggest risk wherever identified.
	Auditing locations and reviewing IT managers on the support.
	Managing the assets and effectively utilize them based on business requirements. Successful implementation of asset policy and tracking it for 100% compliance as per management requirements.
	Streamlining operation procedures and advising management to adopt modern techniques, which help organization to maintain flawless system

	Manage end to end IT infrastructure of Wipro BPS with more than 50 projects across CDC  (Chennai Development center) & Manjakkudi locations; ensure operational SLA's are met & constantly improved.
	Ensure monitoring and real-time proactive response on all Network, Voice, Server and corresponding ancillary systems.
	Handle all internal, External & Client specific audits for the location and meet the compliance in all IT related action points.
	As a Technology SPOC, handled multiple client visits across different verticals for new business proposals and due diligence in WBPO.
	Managing entire Lifecycle of Projects from Training requirements, Transition, Go Live and Sustenance.
	Managing the Invoice and sharing the Gross Margin and Billing details to the Central location.
	Responsible for client engagement at onsite and other business optimization services.
	Stimulate healthy competition among the team with various initiatives, setting daily targets, nominate for monthly and quarterly awards, assessments for internal movements, identify training needs and also review them periodically on their performances, thereby maximized productivity and reduced attrition.

•	Leading a 45 member Technology Team spread across 4 locations in Chennai for Wipro BPS, Catering technology services to a wide customer base of 50 demanding international clients.
•	Leading, directing and managing site operations to ensure that the team executes service agreements at, or above the customer's expectations.
•	Managing crisis situations and escalations if any that arises at the site in the most appropriate manner to ensure minimal operations impact and that there are no chances of further escalations.
•	Implementation and continuance of service management based on ITIL framework and ISO 20000 standards for the WBPS Technology Helpdesk. 
•	Conducting Business Review Meetings with the various customers on a regular basis; maximizing profitability through superior customer service, effective and prompt communication and follow-up on all pending actionable with the customer. 
•	Utilizing superior communications skills to motivate the team and to develop effective working relationships with peers, superiors and clients.
•	Branding and marketing the Team and its performance at the Senior Management Level.
•	Assisting the PM in facing internal / external audits and to ensure 100% Risk Management and compliance.
•	Assisting the PM in delegated efforts including but not limited to site financials, resource acquisition, decision making and presentations.
•	Personally coached, trained and mentored team members and provided career development opportunities through training and effective delegation of work.
•	Implementation of Service Improvement Plans and NLD drives including Incident Reduction, Automation etc.
•	Preparation of MIS reports, analyzing trends, identifying shortfalls and working towards overcoming the same.
•	Initializing and implementing initiatives which would in turn lead to Best Practices and also cater to the development of the team members.

•	Responsible for managing the Service Level interval wise and taking necessary steps in the real time and managing the Queue in Real Time management.
•	Conducting conference call with the client on a weekly basis to discuss about the product top issues, Escalations, replacements and issues with the websites
•	Conducting Quality Calibration call with the client on a weekly basis to discuss about the Call and Email quality. 
•	Designed initial and ongoing staffing schedule, aligning with call volume and
  skill set requirements.
•	Rolling out Weekly and Monthly schedule based on the Call Arrival Pattern and 
          Forecasting the calls.
•	Capacity Planning to meet the Client Requirements
•	Responsible for ensuring the CSAT% is met with the clients target 
•	Generate Reports and Presentation for Client Reviews & Business Reviews.
